eventTemplate.title: [Camunda Application] ZeebeSLORequestFailureRate
eventTemplate.description:
gRPC-equivalent gateway failure rate > 0.5% in namespace {dims} — Zeebe's 99.5% availability SLO is breached.

IMPORTANT SUBSTITUTION: the source rule computes this from grpc_server_handled_total filtered to code=DEADLINE_EXCEEDED|UNAVAILABLE. That metric is pre-Micrometer and does not exist on Camunda 8.7's native OTLP push — metric-mapping-8.7.md only carries the histogram grpc.server.processing.duration forward, and Grail can't read a histogram's observation count (the same reason three gRPC dashboard panels were rewritten/dropped). This alert instead uses zeebe.gateway.failed.requests / zeebe.gateway.total.requests, a gateway-wide failure ratio rather than one scoped to those two specific gRPC status codes. Verify the requestType dimension name/values in your tenant before trusting the CreateProcessInstanceWithResult exclusion.
